time: logical causal phase ticks score3t/decision3t+1/mutation3t+2; wallclock not semantic latency
row: one row per evaluation point; every WAIT and no-write retained
selected_ids: newly selected current IDs; not necessarily loss-exposed
buffer_entry_exit: exact queued/flush IDs, pre/post lengths; pending final IDs in run manifest
candidate: start/count/reset; no payload buffer/replay in Q
loss: IDs and weights of actual operator call; effective_written IDs only if full parameter hash changed
paths: parameter/adapter/optimizer/scaler-EMA/reference/calibration/encoder flags mandatory; all except decoder frozen or absent
state: SHA256 frozen encoder/scaler/references/tau/invcov plus decoder before/after
snapshots: decoder after every output; evaluator read-only probes reconstruct any timing
